chunks.title: Sliding systems
chunks.body:
Glaze sliding aluminium window and door systems — precision rollers, sashes to 300 kg, spans to six metres.
Walls of glass that move with a fingertip — and stand still against everything else.
Precision-engineered stainless rollers carry the sash instead of dragging it, so a panel weighing 300 kg moves under one hand. Nothing swings into the room and nothing crowds the view — the pane simply steps aside.
The sliding series run from a modest balcony door to a six-metre glazed elevation. Whichever depth a project needs, the thermally broken core, the German hardware and the tested seal are the same.
Best suited to: Panoramic, Wide openings, Sea-facing, Minimal sightlines.
Key figures — Max sash weight: 300kg. Max sash height: 6m. Water tight, no leakage: 600Pa. Best U-value in range: 2.087W/m²K.
Fingertip glide — Twin stainless rollers on a hardened track. The weight is carried, not dragged — the panel takes the same effort at 60 kg and 300 kg.
Spans to six metres — The 201 series takes a single sash six metres tall, letting one pane do the work an entire wall used to.
Sealed against weather — Class 4 air permeability and 600 Pa of water tightness with no leakage — tested to BS EN 12207 and 12208.
Quiet inside — Rw 41–44 dB across the range. Laminated acoustic glazing brings a main road down to a background murmur.
Series that fit Sliding: GWS-N1-105 SD, GWS-N1-135 SD, GWS-N1-155 SD, GWS-N1-155 SD + SN, GWS-N1-201 SD, GWS-N1-201 SD + SN.
chunks.keywords: Sliding sliding Panoramic Wide openings Sea-facing Minimal sightlines

chunks.title: Casement systems
chunks.body:
Glaze casement aluminium windows and doors — concealed hinges, multi-point locking, leaves to 130 kg and 2.8 metres tall.
Sashes that swing clear of the frame — every opening a whole opening.
An outward-opening sash on concealed hinges clears the frame entirely, so the whole opening becomes airflow rather than a gap at the top. Multi-point locking then draws the leaf into a continuous gasket on every edge, not just beside the handle.
The casement family runs from a single window to a full-height double door, sharing the thermally broken core and the tested seal with every other Glaze system.
Best suited to: Cross-ventilation, Tall leaves, Weather-facing, Concealed hinges.
Key figures — Max leaf weight: 130kg. Max leaf height: 2.8m. Water tight, no leakage: 600Pa. Best U-value in range: 2.087W/m²K.
Concealed hinges — Nothing breaks the line of the frame when the sash is shut, and nothing collects dirt where the two meet.
Multi-point locking — Locking points run the full sash edge, so the gasket is compressed evenly rather than only at one point.
Leaves to 2.8 metres — The 130 and 150 series carry a 2800 mm leaf at up to 130 kg — tall enough for full-height glazing.
Sealed against weather — Class 4 air permeability and 600 Pa of water tightness with no leakage — tested to BS EN 12207 and 12208.
Series that fit Casement: GWS-N1-60H, GWS-N1-60 D/DD, GWS-N1-130 FS+SN / D/DD, GWS-N1-150-50+60 FS+SN / D/DD.
chunks.keywords: Casement casement Cross-ventilation Tall leaves Weather-facing Concealed hinges

chunks.title: Lift & Slide systems
chunks.body:
Glaze lift and slide aluminium doors — sashes to 300 kg, six metres of height, airtight the moment the handle is released.
Turn the handle and the panel lifts off its seal. Release it and the whole weight settles back down.
The handle raises the sash clear of its gasket before it travels, so a 300 kg panel moves under one hand and the seal is never dragged along its own length. Release the handle and that same weight presses the gasket shut again.
Lift and slide runs on the heavy sliding-door profiles — the series carrying sashes from 120 kg to 300 kg, at heights up to six metres.
Best suited to: Panoramic, Heavy panels, Sea-facing, Airtight.
Key figures — Max sash weight: 300kg. Max sash height: 6m. Peak sound insulation: 44Rw dB. Best U-value in range: 2.087W/m²K.
Lift, then glide — The gasket is only under load when the door is closed, so it never wears against the track.
Sashes to 300 kg — The 201 series carries a 300 kg leaf — a pane most systems would have to split in two.
Six metres tall — A single sash spans six metres of height, so the opening is set by the architecture rather than the hardware.
Airtight when set — Dropping the sash compresses the seal on every edge — Class 4 air permeability, 600 Pa water tightness.
Series that fit Lift & Slide: GWS-N1-135 SD, GWS-N1-155 SD, GWS-N1-201 SD, GWS-N1-201 SD + SN.
chunks.keywords: Lift & Slide lift-and-slide Panoramic Heavy panels Sea-facing Airtight

chunks.title: Bi-Fold systems
chunks.body:
Glaze bi-fold aluminium doors — leaves that stack aside to open a whole elevation, with flush thresholds and 150 kg capacity.
Leaf after leaf stacks aside until nothing at all stands in the opening.
Each leaf runs on its own carriage and folds flat against the next, so an entire elevation gathers into a stack roughly the width of one panel. Nothing swings into the room and nothing is left standing in the middle of the opening.
The folding series take leaves up to 800 × 1600 mm inside an overall opening of 1500 × 2200 mm, at 45 kg a leaf and 150 kg of system capacity.
Best suited to: Full-width openings, Terraces, Garden rooms, Flush thresholds.
Key figures — System capacity: 150kg. Per folding leaf: 45kg. Overall opening height: 2200mm. Best U-value in range: 2.087W/m²K.
Folds to a stack — The leaves gather at one jamb rather than sliding behind each other, so the opening is genuinely clear.
Flush thresholds — The track can sit level with the finished floor — which matters most where a room runs straight out onto a terrace.
45 kg a leaf — Light enough to move in sequence with one hand, inside a system rated to 150 kg in total.
Sealed against weather — Every leaf closes onto the same gasket line — Class 4 air permeability and 600 Pa of water tightness.
Series that fit Bi-Fold: GWS-N1-60FS, GWS-N1-125-45 30+60FS, GWS-N1-130 FS+SN / D/DD, GWS-N1-150-50+60 FS+SN / D/DD.
chunks.keywords: Bi-Fold bi-fold Full-width openings Terraces Garden rooms Flush thresholds

chunks.title: Pivot systems
chunks.body:
Glaze pivot aluminium windows — oversized panels balanced on a single axis, sealed all round when closed.
An oversized panel that turns on a single silent axis, in balance at every angle.
The panel rotates about its own centre rather than hanging off one edge, so the load sits on the axis instead of the hinge side. That is what lets the format grow well past what a hinged sash would carry at the same frame depth.
Because it is balanced, a very large pane stays exactly where it is left — half open is a position, not something you have to hold.
Best suited to: Statement openings, Oversized formats, Courtyards, Perfect balance.
Key figures — Water tight, no leakage: 600Pa. Peak sound insulation: 44Rw dB. Best U-value in range: 2.087W/m²K.
Central-axis rotation — The load sits on the axis, not on one edge, so the panel does not drop out of square over the years.
Oversized formats — Panes far larger than a hinged sash could carry, in a frame that stays slim.
Stays where you leave it — A balanced panel holds any angle without a stay or a catch.
Sealed all round — Closed, the gasket runs unbroken around the full perimeter of the frame.
Series that fit Pivot: .
chunks.keywords: Pivot pivot Statement openings Oversized formats Courtyards Perfect balance

chunks.title: Fixed systems
chunks.body:
Glaze fixed aluminium windows — the thinnest possible frame around a permanent pane, with no moving parts at all.
No hinges, no rails, no motion — only the thinnest frame we can draw around a pane of glass.
With nothing to open there is nothing to accommodate: no sash inside the frame, no hardware in the reveal, no clearance left for movement. What remains is very close to glass held in a line.
Fixed lights are usually specified alongside an opening system, taking the spans that never need to open so the operable panels can stay a sensible size.
Best suited to: Picture windows, Maximum glass, Thinnest sightlines, Zero maintenance.
Key figures — Water tight, no leakage: 600Pa. Peak sound insulation: 44Rw dB.
Zero moving parts — Nothing to wear, adjust or service — the assembly is the same in year twenty as on the day it was set.
Thinnest sightlines — Without a sash inside the frame, the visible aluminium comes down to the structural minimum.
Maximum glass — More of the opening is glazed than any operable system can manage at the same size.
Sealed permanently — A continuous bond rather than a compression seal, so there is no gasket line to maintain.
Series that fit Fixed: .
chunks.keywords: Fixed fixed Picture windows Maximum glass Thinnest sightlines Zero maintenance

chunks.title: About Glaze Window Systems
chunks.body:
Glaze Window Systems designs, fabricates and installs premium aluminium window and door systems. The house line is "Designed to Disappear" — the intent is that the architecture and the view are what you notice, not the frame.
Glaze is an independent company and has been working in aluminium since 1989. Fabrication and installation are handled in-house rather than subcontracted, which is what lets the same team stand behind the tested performance figures on the finished opening.
The workshop and offices are in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana.

chunks.title: How a Glaze project runs
chunks.body:
A project moves through six steps: consultation, site survey, design and drawings, fabrication, installation, and handover. Consultation establishes a realistic budget and timeline; the site survey lasers every opening to the millimetre once the structure is ready; drawings settle sightlines, finishes and hardware before anything is made; profiles are cut, machined and assembled in-house; certified teams fit and seal on site, most installations completing within the week; handover covers care guidance, warranty and a single point of contact.
Specification is done for the actual elevation rather than from a catalogue: frame, glass, spacer and opening ratio are calculated together, because a high-performance frame carrying the wrong glazing performs like neither.
For an accurate lead time or a quotation on a live project, the team needs the drawings or the opening sizes — contact them directly.
chunks.keywords: process how it works lead time survey installation steps timeline consultation drawings fabrication handover

chunks.title: Performance, testing and standards
chunks.body:
Glaze systems are tested to European standards: BS EN 12207 for air permeability and BS EN 12208 for water tightness.
Across the range, water tightness is 600 Pa with no leakage and air permeability reaches Class 4. Acoustic performance is Rw 41–44 dB depending on series and glazing; laminated acoustic glass brings a main road down to a background murmur.
Thermal transmittance runs from about 2.58 to 2.60 W/m²K on the standard series, with the best U-value in the sliding range at 2.087 W/m²K. Every profile is thermally broken with a polyamide bar separating the inner and outer aluminium shells.
chunks.keywords: performance u-value uvalue thermal acoustic rw db noise water air pa wind test standard en 12207 en 12208 certified

chunks.title: Glass options
chunks.body:
Glaze glazes with single, double and laminated units, including low-emissivity and solar-control coatings and acoustic laminated build-ups.
Glass is specified with the frame, not after it. A double-glazed unit in a frame with no thermal break will still condense on the aluminium while the glass stays clear, and a high-specification frame carrying single glazing wastes most of what it cost.
The right build-up depends on orientation, exposure and what the room is for — the systems team will run the combined calculation for a specific elevation.
chunks.keywords: glass glazing double glazed dgu laminated low-e toughened acoustic glass solar

chunks.title: Hardware
chunks.body:
Systems are fitted with German hardware rated to 25,000 operating cycles.
Sliding and lift-and-slide sashes run on twin stainless rollers over a hardened track, so the weight is carried rather than dragged and a 300 kg panel moves under one hand.
Locking, handles and hinges are matched to the series and to the sash weight rather than fitted as a single default.
chunks.keywords: hardware handle lock roller hinge german cycles ironmongery

chunks.title: Finishes and colours
chunks.body:
Frames are available powder-coated to RAL colours, anodised, and in wood-effect finishes.
Any RAL reference can be matched. Finish affects appearance and durability in exposure but not the structural or thermal figures of the series.
chunks.keywords: finish colour color ral powder coat anodised wood texture

chunks.title: Visiting, quotations and getting in touch
chunks.body:
The showroom and workshop are in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad. Visits are best booked in advance so a systems specialist is free to walk through the profiles with you.
Pricing is always project-specific — it depends on the series, the glass build-up, opening sizes, finish and quantity — so there is no published price list. Send the drawings or the opening sizes through the contact form and the team will come back with a quotation.
The enquiry form on the contact page routes straight to the systems team, and a confirmation is sent back automatically.
